name: Forks
what: You fork a computer, or one of its checkpoints, into a copy-on-write clone that lives its own life while the computer it came from loses nothing. The fork gets a new identity with its scheduled jobs off and no copied logins or secrets unless you say so, and never gets wider reach than its parent has.

suggest.why: A fork is how an agent tries something risky without touching main, which `the-shape` names as one of the reasons for Silo.
